description: Pre-match ATP tennis features for the XGBoost match-winner model. All values are numeric and ordered for direct Rust runner parity.

features.name: elo_diff
features.description: Overall Elo difference: player_1 minus player_2.

features.name: surface_elo_diff
features.description: Surface-specific Elo difference: player_1 minus player_2.

features.name: rank_log_advantage
features.description: Positive when player_1 has the better ATP rank, using log1p ranks.

features.name: seed_advantage
features.description: Positive when player_1 has the better tournament seed.

features.name: age_diff
features.description: Player_1 age minus player_2 age in years.

features.name: height_cm_diff
features.description: Player_1 listed height minus player_2 listed height in centimeters.

features.name: h2h_win_pct_diff
features.description: Smoothed head-to-head win-rate edge for player_1 before the match.

features.name: recent_win_pct_diff
features.description: Smoothed recent-form win-rate edge over the configured rolling window.

features.name: recent_match_count_diff
features.description: Difference in available recent-form sample counts.

features.name: days_rest_diff
features.description: Player_1 days since prior match minus player_2 days since prior match.

features.name: best_of_5
features.description: 1 when the match is best-of-five, else 0.

features.name: is_grand_slam
features.description: 1 when tourney_level is Grand Slam, else 0.

features.name: p1_implied_prob
features.description: Bookmaker implied probability for player_1 after overround normalization.

features.name: implied_prob_diff
features.description: Normalized implied probability edge: p1_implied_prob - p2_implied_prob.

features.name: odds_overround
features.description: Raw reciprocal-odds sum before normalization.

features.name: surface_hard
features.description: 1 for hard-court matches, else 0.

features.name: surface_clay
features.description: 1 for clay-court matches, else 0.

features.name: surface_grass
features.description: 1 for grass-court matches, else 0.

features.name: surface_carpet
features.description: 1 for carpet matches, else 0.

features.name: surface_unknown
features.description: 1 when the surface is missing or outside the known surface set.
